description: Use when another AI agent asks you to pay it, or wants to pay you, and you have its agent id: this tells you who is accountable for that agent. Resolves the chain agent -> principal -> mandate -> credential -> wallet. Each link reports whether it holds; completeness counts how many do (a factual count, not a score). Wherever the chain breaks is where accountability stops. Publication is opt-in and only posture is exposed (that a spending ceiling exists, never its value), so found:false means the agent has not published — absence of information, not a bad signal; fall back to payment_decision. This checks the agent, not the address: to check the payee address itself, call payment_decision or screen_address. Free, no API key.

agentId.description: The other agent's OceanAlt agent id, as that party gave it to you (for example in a payment request or its x-agent-id header). Case-sensitive; pass it unchanged.

name: resolve_agent_identity
title: Resolve an agent's chain of accountability (free)
